Name: Volcano Farm
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Replaces a farm and farm cave maps with larger volcano-themed maps.

You can choose which farm map this mod replaces!
Run the game with this mod once, then go into the config.json and change the Farm option to one of the following values: Standard, Forest, Riverland, Wilderness, Hill-top, Four Corners, or Beach. 

Happy New Year's Eve!! If there are any mistakes, it's because I am a leeeettle tipsy rn.
